about: fk-gallery's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk9-reload-while-loading
mutants.from:
case Loading:
			// The load in flight answers this visit too.
mutants.rule: A visit while the catalog loads asks for no second load (test ReenteringWhileLoadingAsksNoMore; law CatalogueLoadsOncePerVisit).

mutants.name: fk9-gallery-stay-loads
mutants.from:
case (Gallery, Gallery):
		// A stay on the gallery is no entry.
mutants.rule: Only an entry into the gallery loads the catalog, not a stay (law CatalogueLoadsOncePerVisit).

mutants.name: fk9-stay-always-refetches
mutants.rule: A stay on a painting with the same id loads nothing (test StayingWithTheSameIdDoesNotRefetch; law StayRefetchesOnlyOnIdChange).

mutants.name: fk9-stay-never-refetches
mutants.rule: A stay on a painting with another id loads it (test StayingWithANewIdRefetches).

mutants.name: fk9-empty-draft-saved
mutants.rule: Leaving the studio with an empty draft saves nothing (test LeavingAnEmptyStudioSavesNothing).

mutants.name: fk9-save-on-stay
mutants.rule: Staying in the studio is no exit and saves nothing (law LeavingStudioSavesDraft).

mutants.name: fk9-stale-answer-taken
mutants.rule: An answer for another painting than the one loading is ignored (test AStaleAnswerForAnotherIdIsIgnored).

mutants.name: fk9-log-unbounded
mutants.rule: The log keeps the last 20 navigations (law LogKeepsTheLastTwenty).

mutants.name: fk9-studio-parses-home
mutants.rule: Every route of the site prints to a path that parses back to it (law RoutesRoundTrip).
